proposed.text: Per PD 1096 Rule XII, Sec. 1207(7), what is the minimum net floor area per person for a dispersal area serving non-ambulatory occupants in a horizontal exit?
proposed.rationale: Original question was already source-correct and substantive; the prior edit (source-audited-article-batch-048) was degenerate, with 1-character garbage in 3 of 4 option text fields and a nonsensical rationale. Restored the original verbatim. Original source rationale: Per Rule XII, Sec. 1207(7), the dispersal area net floor area is 0.30 sq.m/person for ambulatory occupants and 1.90 sq.m/person for non-ambulatory occupants. Non-ambulatory occupants (hospital patients on beds, wheelchair users) require significantly more space for evacuation via horizontal exit.
